title: Legacy zeppelinos proxy implementation slot
detects: A non-zero value is the current logic contract of a pre-EIP-1967 OpenZeppelin proxy.
knownFalseNegative: This slot is empty on modern proxies. It complements proxy-eip1967 rather than replacing it. Both must be read.

coversExamples.observed: implementation 0x43506849d7c04f9138d1a2050bbf3a0c054402dd. EIP-1967 slot reads zero for this token.

rationale: THE canonical reason this dictionary exists. USDC, the most widely held stablecoin in crypto, is upgradeable and is invisible to an EIP-1967-only reader. Any scanner missing this slot reports the single most important token on Ethereum as non-upgradeable.
